page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d3s.16xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 381,393 GB of hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This high-density local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 80 Gbps, enabling high-throughput data transfers. The instance does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d3s.16xlarge is its reliance on HDD storage rather than solid-state drives (SSDs), which prioritizes sheer capacity and sequential throughput over low-latency random I/O operations. This profile is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive storage volume per compute unit without the premium cost of SSDs. Suitable workloads include large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, big data analytics, and cold storage archiving.
